content: While some retailers were offering preorder discounts on the remastered Legend of Zelda: The Ocarina of Time, it’s not too late to save if you missed out. Costco members can currently get $5 off the digital version online, bringing the price down to $54.99. Considering an annual Costco membership runs $65, that discount almost offsets one month of your plan — a prime example of “gamer math.” [Product: The Legend of Zelda: The Ocarina of Time | https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.costco.com%2Fp%2F-%2Fthe-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time---nintendo-switch-2-digital-code%2F4201058476] My colleague Andrew Webster recently shared his thoughts on Nintendo’s latest Switch 2 exclusive, noting how impressed he was with how much impact a few modern quality-of-life changes had on what is otherwise a classic experience. The updated graphics are as thoughtful as they are beautiful, pairing realistic scenery with puppet-like characters. Perhaps, more importantly, Link can now jump anytime he likes, rather than being limited to specific ledges.

chineseContent: 虽然一些零售商为重制版《塞尔达传说：时之笛》提供预购折扣，但如果您错过了，现在还不算太晚。目前，Costco 会员在线购买数字版可享受 5 美元折扣，价格降至 54.99 美元。考虑到 Costco 会员年费为 65 美元，这一折扣几乎抵消了你一个月的计划——这是“玩家数学”的一个典型例子。 [产品：塞尔达传说：时之笛| https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.costco.com%2Fp%2F-%2Fthe-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time---nintendo-switch-2-digital-code%2F4201058476]我的同事安德鲁·韦伯斯特最近分享了他的想法任天堂最新的 Switch 2 独家报道，指出现代生活质量的一些变化对经典体验的影响给他留下了深刻的印象。更新后的图形既精美又深思熟虑，将现实的风景与木偶般的角色结合在一起。也许，更重要的是，林克现在可以随时跳跃，而不必局限于特定的壁架。
